sources.locator: Sections 2.1 and 2.2, equations (1)–(5), rendered lines 96–128; adjacent section 2.4 accumulator discussion, lines 147–155
sources.supports: Separate operand scales and zero points; integer product accumulation and product-of-scales relationship to the corresponding real matrix product; a wider integer accumulator than quantized operands.
sources.doesNotSupport: No transfer of the paper's hardware speed, accuracy, memory reduction or training outcomes. This adapter uses authored symmetric zero-point-zero tiles, signed-int32 storage for every operand code and binary64 host rescaling, not the full affine fixed-point integer-only pipeline or quantization-aware training.
